# Lepons

> Lepons is a free desktop app (Windows, macOS) that runs Claude Code and Codex sessions from several PCs — this PC and remote servers or VMs over SSH — in one window, and lets those PCs share codebases live through an MCP server tunnelled over SSH.

- Download: https://github.com/joyuno/lepons/releases/latest
- Guide (Korean): https://github.com/joyuno/lepons/blob/main/README.md
- Guide (English): https://github.com/joyuno/lepons/blob/main/README.en.md

## Key facts
- Nothing is installed on remote PCs; SSH is enough. tmux keeps sessions alive across disconnects; if a remote PC lacks it, Lepons installs it in one click (asking for the sudo password in its own dialog when needed, never saved).
- Sharing: drag a folder onto another PC on the sharing map; that PC's agents read it with `search_repo` and `read_file`, file by file, with secrets masked. They can also hand work to the owning PC with `delegate_task`, which runs there without permission prompts.
- Shows Claude Code and Codex plan usage (5-hour and 7-day limits) as batteries; Claude usage updates after each reply on this PC and when a remote session finishes a turn.
- Phone app (1.8.0, iOS and Android, coming soon to the App Store and Google Play): pairs with the desktop app through a relay (relay.lepons.app) by scanning a QR code and comparing six digits on both screens, then signs in with a password plus an Authenticator (TOTP) code. Traffic is end-to-end encrypted; the relay cannot read it. Shows running, waiting and finished sessions grouped like the PC's panes and tabs, Claude and Codex usage limits, a session's conversation (menu numbers, typed lines, Enter, stop with Esc; it cannot end the agent), workflow, files (Markdown, PDF, images) and a work map per PC. Push notifications only for "waiting for input" (coalesced) and an optional quiet "all done"; they carry only the PC's name. Privacy: https://lepons.app/privacy, support: https://lepons.app/support.
- PC-to-PC connections are SSH only; one PC drives every VM and PC it can reach over SSH. On Windows, Lepons can turn on the OpenSSH server with a LAN-only firewall rule.
- Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Antigravity and Cursor. The workflow map (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+M) shows every PC as a hub with its folders, sessions and subagents, each with a summary (goal, current step, result); it is watch-only.
- Optional desktop pet (produck) that shows which session is waiting for input; custom characters can be imported.
- One prompt can be sent to several sessions at once; open sessions are offered back after a crash or a normal close.
